why.en: One of the original authors of 'Attention Is All You Need' and the key contributor behind MoE and multi-query attention. Returned to Google in 2024 to co-lead Gemini — then left for OpenAI in June 2026.
why.zh: 《Attention Is All You Need》第一批作者之一，MoE 与多查询注意力的关键贡献者。2024 年回归 Google 联合领导 Gemini —— 2026 年 6 月转投 OpenAI。

title.en: Attention Is All You Need
title.zh: Attention Is All You Need

title.en: Fast Transformer decoding: one write-head is all you need
title.zh: 快速 Transformer 解码：一个写头就够了

note.en: Multi-query attention — the reason modern inference is affordable at all.
note.zh: 多查询注意力 —— 现代推理之所以负担得起的原因。

title.en: Live from #GoogleIO, we’re introducing Gemini 3.5 Flash, our latest model with frontier performance for agents and coding. We’re rolling it out globally today,
title.zh: Live from #GoogleIO, we’re introducing Gemini 3.5 Flash, our latest model with frontier performance for agents and coding. We’re rolling it out globally today,

note.en: Shazeer announced the launch of Gemini 3.5 Flash, a new frontier model optimized for agents and coding, unveiled live at Google I/O.
note.zh: Shazeer宣布推出Gemini 3.5 Flash,这是一款针对智能体和编程优化的新前沿模型,在谷歌I/O大会上现场发布。

title.en: Gemini 3.1 Flash Live is now available, and it’s built for production-ready reliability. We’ve improved its overall quality so developers and enterprises can bu
title.zh: Gemini 3.1 Flash Live is now available, and it’s built for production-ready reliability. We’ve improved its overall quality so developers and enterprises can bu

note.en: Shazeer announced Gemini 3.1 Flash Live, built for production-ready reliability to support voice-first agent applications.
note.zh: Shazeer宣布推出Gemini 3.1 Flash Live,专为生产级可靠性打造,以支持语音优先的智能体应用。

title.en: 📢Introducing Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, our fastest and most efficient model, built for high-volume workloads. It outperforms 2.5 Flash in reasoning, reliability, a
title.zh: 📢Introducing Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, our fastest and most efficient model, built for high-volume workloads. It outperforms 2.5 Flash in reasoning, reliability, a

note.en: Shazeer introduced Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, the fastest and most efficient Gemini model yet, aimed at high-volume workloads.
note.zh: Shazeer发布了Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite,这是迄今最快、最高效的Gemini模型,面向高负载场景。

title.en: Last week we upgraded Gemini 3 Deep Think. Today, we’re shipping the core intelligence that makes those breakthroughs possible: Gemini 3.1 Pro. A noticeably sma
title.zh: Last week we upgraded Gemini 3 Deep Think. Today, we’re shipping the core intelligence that makes those breakthroughs possible: Gemini 3.1 Pro. A noticeably sma

note.en: Shazeer announced Gemini 3.1 Pro, a smarter and more capable baseline model shipping the core intelligence behind Gemini 3 Deep Think's improvements.
note.zh: Shazeer宣布推出Gemini 3.1 Pro,这是一款更智能、能力更强的基础模型,承载了Gemini 3 Deep Think升级背后的核心智能。

title.en: An updated Gemini 3 Deep Think is out today: 📈 Achieves SOTA on ARC-AGI-2, MMMU-Pro, and HLE. 🥇Gold-medal level on Physics & Chemistry Olympiads. It turns o
title.zh: An updated Gemini 3 Deep Think is out today: 📈 Achieves SOTA on ARC-AGI-2, MMMU-Pro, and HLE. 🥇Gold-medal level on Physics & Chemistry Olympiads. It turns o

note.en: Shazeer announced an updated Gemini 3 Deep Think achieving state-of-the-art results on ARC-AGI-2, MMMU-Pro and HLE, plus gold-medal performance on physics and chemistry olympiads.
note.zh: Shazeer宣布更新版Gemini 3 Deep Think在ARC-AGI-2、MMMU-Pro和HLE上取得了最先进的成绩,并在物理和化学奥赛中达到金牌水平。

title.en: Gemini 3 Flash is live. ⚡️ We’ve packed Gemini 3’s Pro-grade reasoning into a leaner model with Flash-level latency, efficiency, and cost. It's my favorite mode
title.zh: Gemini 3 Flash is live. ⚡️ We’ve packed Gemini 3’s Pro-grade reasoning into a leaner model with Flash-level latency, efficiency, and cost. It's my favorite mode

note.en: Shazeer announced Gemini 3 Flash, packing Gemini 3's pro-grade reasoning into a leaner, lower-latency model.
note.zh: Shazeer宣布推出Gemini 3 Flash,将Gemini 3的专业级推理能力压缩进一款延迟更低、更精简的模型中。

title.en: Gemini 3 Deep Think mode is live for Ultra users today. When using parallel lines of thought in this mode, Gemini shows meaningful improvement on key reasoning
title.zh: Gemini 3 Deep Think mode is live for Ultra users today. When using parallel lines of thought in this mode, Gemini shows meaningful improvement on key reasoning

note.en: Shazeer announced Gemini 3 Deep Think mode going live for Ultra subscribers, using parallel lines of thought to improve results on key reasoning benchmarks.
note.zh: Shazeer宣布Gemini 3 Deep Think模式已面向Ultra订阅用户上线,通过并行思维链提升关键推理基准测试的表现。

title.en: Hot ChipsKeynote
title.zh: Hot ChipsKeynote

note.en: Shazeer's Hot Chips 2025 keynote, 'Predictions for the Next Phase of AI,' arguing compute, memory bandwidth and lower precision will drive the next generation of models.
note.zh: 沙泽尔在2025年Hot Chips大会的主题演讲《AI下一阶段的预测》，主张算力、内存带宽和低精度计算将驱动下一代模型发展。

title.en: Gemini 2.5: Pushing the Frontier with Advanced Reasoning, Multimodality, Long Context, and Next Generation Agentic Capabilities
title.zh: Gemini 2.5: Pushing the Frontier with Advanced Reasoning, Multimodality, Long Context, and Next Generation Agentic Capabilities

note.en: Gemini 2.5 technical report covering the family's reasoning, long-context, multimodal and agentic capabilities.
note.zh: Gemini 2.5 技术报告，介绍该系列模型的推理、长上下文、多模态与智能体能力。

title.en: Gemma 3 Technical Report
title.zh: Gemma 3 Technical Report

note.en: Technical report for Gemma 3, Google's open multimodal model family from 1B to 27B parameters; Shazeer is a senior author on the release.
note.zh: Gemma 3 技术报告，介绍谷歌参数规模从 10 亿到 270 亿的开源多模态模型系列，Shazeer 是该报告的资深作者之一。

title.en: Introducing Gemini 2.5 Pro Experimental. The 2.5 series marks a significant evolution: Gemini models are now fundamentally thinking models. This means the model
title.zh: Introducing Gemini 2.5 Pro Experimental. The 2.5 series marks a significant evolution: Gemini models are now fundamentally thinking models. This means the model

note.en: Shazeer introduced Gemini 2.5 Pro Experimental, describing it as marking Gemini's evolution into fundamentally 'thinking' models that reason before responding.
note.zh: Shazeer发布了Gemini 2.5 Pro Experimental,称其标志着Gemini演变为在回答前先进行推理的'思维'模型。

title.en: Ep 58: Google Researchers Noam Shazeer and Jack Rae on Scaling Test-time Compute, Reactions to Ilya & AGI
title.zh: Ep 58: Google Researchers Noam Shazeer and Jack Rae on Scaling Test-time Compute, Reactions to Ilya & AGI

note.en: Long-form interview with Shazeer and Jack Rae on scaling test-time compute and where reasoning models go next.
note.zh: Shazeer 与 Jack Rae 的长篇访谈，讨论测试时计算的扩展以及推理模型的下一步方向。

title.en: Jeff Dean & Noam Shazeer — 25 years at Google: from PageRank to AGI
title.zh: Jeff Dean & Noam Shazeer — 25 years at Google: from PageRank to AGI

note.en: Dwarkesh Podcast interview with Shazeer and Jeff Dean covering 25 years of Google infrastructure and model work, from PageRank to Gemini.
note.zh: Dwarkesh 播客对 Shazeer 与 Jeff Dean 的访谈，回顾在谷歌二十五年间从 PageRank 到 Gemini 的基础设施与模型工作。

title.en: Your feedback on Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking has been incredible—thank you! We’ve taken your suggestions and made an experimental update…
title.zh: Your feedback on Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking has been incredible—thank you! We’ve taken your suggestions and made an experimental update…

note.en: Shazeer announced an experimental update to Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking based on user feedback.
note.zh: Shazeer宣布基于用户反馈对Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking进行了实验性更新。

title.en: We’ve been *thinking* about how to improve model reasoning and explainability Introducing Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking, an experimental model trained to think out
title.zh: We’ve been *thinking* about how to improve model reasoning and explainability Introducing Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking, an experimental model trained to think out

note.en: Shazeer introduced Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking, an experimental model trained to reason out loud for stronger performance.
note.zh: Shazeer发布了Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking,这是一款经过训练可以'出声思考'以提升推理表现的实验性模型。

title.en: Incredibly proud of the team for our official launch of Character Calls!
title.zh: Incredibly proud of the team for our official launch of Character Calls!

note.en: Shazeer announced the official launch of Character Calls, a voice-calling feature for Character.AI, the company he co-founded.
note.zh: Shazeer宣布了Character Calls的正式上线,这是他联合创立的Character.AI的语音通话功能。

title.en: Character AI is serving 20,000 QPS. Here are the technologies we use to serve hyper-efficiently. [https://t.co/R14Jt9Z5yo ]
title.zh: Character AI is serving 20,000 QPS. Here are the technologies we use to serve hyper-efficiently. [https://t.co/R14Jt9Z5yo ]

note.en: Shazeer shared that Character.AI was serving 20,000 queries per second and detailed the engineering techniques used to serve models hyper-efficiently at that scale.
note.zh: Shazeer透露Character.AI的服务规模已达到每秒2万次查询,并介绍了支撑这一效率的工程技术。

title.en: https://t.co/abQu8pN4WJ Check out my first blog post.
title.zh: https://t.co/abQu8pN4WJ Check out my first blog post.

note.en: Shazeer linked to his first personal blog post, sharing it directly with followers.
note.zh: Shazeer分享了他的第一篇个人博客文章的链接。

title.en: As a friendly competitor in the AI space, we share a core mission of building AI technology that benefits every person. While we don’t know the specifics, we ar
title.zh: As a friendly competitor in the AI space, we share a core mission of building AI technology that benefits every person. While we don’t know the specifics, we ar

note.en: Shazeer, then at Character.AI, publicly expressed solidarity with OpenAI as a 'friendly competitor' amid OpenAI's leadership turmoil, saying they share a core mission despite not knowing the specifics.
note.zh: 当时任职于Character.AI的Shazeer在OpenAI高层动荡期间公开表态,称双方是'友好的竞争对手',共享着建设造福所有人的AI技术这一核心使命,尽管他们并不清楚具体细节。

title.en: AI Revolution: Universally Accessible Intelligence with Character.ai's Noam Shazeer
title.zh: AI Revolution: Universally Accessible Intelligence with Character.ai's Noam Shazeer

note.en: Shazeer in conversation with a16z on making intelligence universally accessible and the compute required to serve it at Character.AI.
note.zh: Shazeer 与 a16z 对谈，讨论让智能普惠可及的构想，以及 Character.AI 为此所需的算力规模。

title.en: 20VC: Spending $2M to Train a Single AI Model: What Matters More; Model Size or Data Size | Hallucinations: Feature or Bug | Will Everyone Have an AI Friend in the Future & Raising $150M from a16z with Noam Shazeer, Co-Founder & CEO @ Character.ai
title.zh: 20VC: Spending $2M to Train a Single AI Model: What Matters More; Model Size or Data Size | Hallucinations: Feature or Bug | Will Everyone Have an AI Friend in the Future & Raising $150M from a16z with Noam Shazeer, Co-Founder & CEO @ Character.ai

posts.source: The Twenty Minute VC (20VC): Venture C…

note.en: Shazeer on 20VC discussing model size versus data size, whether hallucination is a feature or a bug, and Character.AI's $150M raise.
note.zh: Shazeer 做客 20VC，讨论模型规模与数据规模孰重、幻觉是特性还是缺陷，以及 Character.AI 的 1.5 亿美元融资。

title.en: Your AI Friends Have Awoken, With Noam Shazeer
title.zh: Your AI Friends Have Awoken, With Noam Shazeer

note.en: A No Priors interview in which Shazeer traces the line from co-inventing the Transformer at Google to building conversational AI companions.
note.zh: Shazeer 做客 No Priors 的访谈，讲述了从在谷歌参与发明 Transformer 到打造对话式 AI 伙伴的这条脉络。

title.en: EP 31 Noam Shazeer - Google veteran and AI inventor on future of AI
title.zh: EP 31 Noam Shazeer - Google veteran and AI inventor on future of AI

note.en: Interview covering Shazeer's path from Transformers, Mesh-TensorFlow and T5 at Google to founding Character.AI.
note.zh: 访谈回顾 Shazeer 从谷歌时期的 Transformer、Mesh-TensorFlow 与 T5，到创办 Character.AI 的历程。

title.en: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways
title.zh: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways

note.en: PaLM, a 540B-parameter dense language model trained with Google's Pathways system, showing strong few-shot performance across tasks.
note.zh: PaLM 论文，介绍使用谷歌 Pathways 系统训练的 5400 亿参数稠密语言模型，在多类任务上展现出色的少样本能力。

title.en: Scaling Up Models and Data with $\texttt{t5x}$ and $\texttt{seqio}$
title.zh: Scaling Up Models and Data with $\texttt{t5x}$ and $\texttt{seqio}$

note.en: Describes t5x and seqio, the JAX libraries Google used to train and evaluate large language models at scale.
note.zh: 介绍 t5x 与 seqio 这两个基于 JAX 的库，谷歌用其大规模训练和评测大语言模型。

title.en: ST-MoE: Designing Stable and Transferable Sparse Expert Models
title.zh: ST-MoE: Designing Stable and Transferable Sparse Expert Models

note.en: ST-MoE tackles the training instability and poor fine-tuning transfer of sparse expert models, a direct follow-on to Shazeer's MoE line of work.
note.zh: ST-MoE 针对稀疏专家模型的训练不稳定与微调迁移不佳问题提出改进，是 Shazeer 混合专家研究脉络的直接延续。

title.en: LaMDA: Language Models for Dialog Applications
title.zh: LaMDA: Language Models for Dialog Applications

note.en: LaMDA, a family of dialog-specialised Transformer language models up to 137B parameters; Shazeer is a lead author and the work later shaped Character.AI.
note.zh: LaMDA 论文，提出面向对话、参数最高达 1370 亿的 Transformer 语言模型系列；Shazeer 是主要作者之一，这项工作后来影响了 Character.AI。

title.en: Searching for Efficient Transformers for Language Modeling
title.zh: Searching for Efficient Transformers for Language Modeling

note.en: NeurIPS paper searching for more efficient transformer architectures for language modeling, co-authored by Shazeer.
note.zh: NeurIPS论文，探索面向语言建模的更高效Transformer架构，沙泽尔为共同作者。

title.en: Primer: Searching for Efficient Transformers for Language Modeling
title.zh: Primer: Searching for Efficient Transformers for Language Modeling

note.en: Primer uses architecture search to find Transformer variants that reach the same quality at substantially lower training cost.
note.zh: Primer 通过架构搜索寻找 Transformer 变体，以显著更低的训练成本达到同等质量。

title.en: GSPMD: General and Scalable Parallelization for ML Computation Graphs
title.zh: GSPMD: General and Scalable Parallelization for ML Computation Graphs

note.en: GSPMD, a compiler-based system that parallelises ML computation graphs automatically from lightweight user annotations.
note.zh: GSPMD 是一套基于编译器的系统，可依据轻量标注自动并行化机器学习计算图。

title.en: GShard: Scaling Giant Models with Conditional Computation and Automatic Sharding
title.zh: GShard: Scaling Giant Models with Conditional Computation and Automatic Sharding

note.en: GShard paper on scaling giant models via conditional computation and automatic sharding — foundational to Shazeer's mixture-of-experts work.
note.zh: 《GShard》论文，通过条件计算和自动分片扩展巨型模型规模，是沙泽尔专家混合研究的奠基性工作。

title.en: Do Transformer Modifications Transfer Across Implementations and Applications?
title.zh: Do Transformer Modifications Transfer Across Implementations and Applications?

note.en: Systematic study finding that most proposed Transformer modifications do not transfer across implementations and tasks.
note.zh: 系统性实验发现，大多数针对 Transformer 的改进换个实现或换个任务后并不能复现收益。

title.en: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
title.zh: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity

note.en: Switch Transformers simplify mixture-of-experts routing to one expert per token, scaling to trillion-parameter models at constant compute per example.
note.zh: Switch Transformer 将混合专家路由简化为每个 token 只选一个专家，在单样本计算量不变的前提下扩展到万亿参数模型。

title.en: Talking-Heads Attention
title.zh: Talking-Heads Attention

note.en: Talking-heads attention, Shazeer's variation on multi-head attention that adds linear projections across the head dimension around the softmax.
note.zh: Talking-heads 注意力，Shazeer 提出的多头注意力变体，在 softmax 前后沿注意力头维度加入线性投影。

title.en: GLU Variants Improve Transformer
title.zh: GLU Variants Improve Transformer

note.en: Single-author note showing that gated linear unit variants in the feed-forward layer improve Transformer quality; the source of the now-standard SwiGLU.
note.zh: Shazeer 独著短文，证明在前馈层使用门控线性单元变体可提升 Transformer 质量，也是如今通用的 SwiGLU 的出处。

title.en: How Much Knowledge Can You Pack Into the Parameters of a Language Model?
title.zh: How Much Knowledge Can You Pack Into the Parameters of a Language Model?

note.en: Measures how much world knowledge a language model can store in its parameters by fine-tuning T5 to answer questions with no external retrieval.
note.zh: 通过微调 T5 在不借助外部检索的情况下回答问题，衡量语言模型参数中能存储多少世界知识。

title.en: Faster Transformer Decoding: N-gram Masked Self-Attention
title.zh: Faster Transformer Decoding: N-gram Masked Self-Attention

note.en: Proposes n-gram masked self-attention, truncating the target-side window to speed up Transformer decoding with little quality loss.
note.zh: 提出 n-gram 掩码自注意力，通过截断目标端窗口加速 Transformer 解码，且质量损失很小。

title.en: Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer
title.zh: Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer

note.en: The T5 paper, which casts every NLP task as text-to-text and systematically compares transfer-learning choices at scale; Shazeer is second author.
note.zh: T5 论文，将所有自然语言处理任务统一为文本到文本形式，并系统比较大规模迁移学习的各项设计选择；Shazeer 为第二作者。

title.en: High Resolution Medical Image Analysis with Spatial Partitioning
title.zh: High Resolution Medical Image Analysis with Spatial Partitioning

note.en: Applies spatial partitioning to train CNNs directly on gigapixel CT and pathology images, an application of Shazeer's Mesh-TensorFlow work.
note.zh: 利用空间划分直接在十亿像素级的 CT 与病理图像上训练卷积网络，是 Shazeer 的 Mesh-TensorFlow 工作的一项应用。

title.en: Corpora Generation for Grammatical Error Correction
title.zh: Corpora Generation for Grammatical Error Correction

note.en: Generates large synthetic corpora for grammatical error correction to address the data scarcity that limits sequence-to-sequence GEC models.
note.zh: 为语法纠错生成大规模合成语料，以缓解制约序列到序列纠错模型的数据稀缺问题。

title.en: Blockwise Parallel Decoding for Deep Autoregressive Models
title.zh: Blockwise Parallel Decoding for Deep Autoregressive Models

note.en: Blockwise parallel decoding predicts several tokens at once and verifies them in parallel, cutting autoregressive decoding latency.
note.zh: 分块并行解码一次预测多个 token 并并行验证，从而降低自回归解码的延迟。

title.en: Mesh-TensorFlow: Deep Learning for Supercomputers
title.zh: Mesh-TensorFlow: Deep Learning for Supercomputers

note.en: Mesh-TensorFlow, Shazeer's framework for splitting model tensors across a mesh of processors so networks too large for data parallelism can be trained.
note.zh: Mesh-TensorFlow 是 Shazeer 主导的框架，将模型张量切分到处理器网格上，使数据并行无法容纳的超大网络得以训练。

title.en: Weakly Supervised Grammatical Error Correction using Iterative Decoding
title.zh: Weakly Supervised Grammatical Error Correction using Iterative Decoding

note.en: Trains a Transformer for grammatical error correction on weakly supervised bitext and improves it with iterative decoding.
note.zh: 在弱监督双语文本上训练 Transformer 进行语法纠错，并通过迭代解码进一步提升效果。

title.en: Music Transformer
title.zh: Music Transformer

note.en: Music Transformer adapts relative attention to model the long-range repetition and structure that music depends on.
note.zh: Music Transformer 改进相对注意力机制，用以建模音乐中依赖的长程重复与结构。

title.en: Adafactor: Adaptive Learning Rates with Sublinear Memory Cost
title.zh: Adafactor: Adaptive Learning Rates with Sublinear Memory Cost

note.en: Adafactor, Shazeer's optimiser that factors the second-moment estimates to train large models with sublinear memory cost.
note.zh: Adafactor 是 Shazeer 提出的优化器，通过分解二阶矩估计，以次线性显存开销训练大模型。

title.en: Tensor2Tensor for Neural Machine Translation
title.zh: Tensor2Tensor for Neural Machine Translation

note.en: Describes Tensor2Tensor, the library carrying the reference implementation of the Transformer for neural machine translation.
note.zh: 介绍 Tensor2Tensor 库，其中包含用于神经机器翻译的 Transformer 参考实现。

title.en: Leaves Google for OpenAI
title.zh: 离开 Google 加入 OpenAI

body.en: The Gemini co-lead's exit was part of a broader DeepMind talent drain — eight prominent researchers left in two months.
body.zh: 这位 Gemini 联合负责人的离开是 DeepMind 更大规模人才流失的一部分 —— 两个月内八名知名研究员出走。

title.en: OpenAI Hires Noam Shazeer and Dean Ball as Company Prepares for IPO
title.zh: OpenAI Hires Noam Shazeer and Dean Ball as Company Prepares for IPO

body.en: Reports confirmed OpenAI hired Noam Shazeer, along with Dean Ball, as the company prepares for an IPO.
body.zh: 报道证实 OpenAI 聘请了 Noam Shazeer（与 Dean Ball 一同加入），此时公司正在筹备上市。

title.en: Google AI veteran and Gemini co-lead Noam Shazeer joins OpenAI
title.zh: Google AI veteran and Gemini co-lead Noam Shazeer joins OpenAI

body.en: Shazeer leaves Google, where he co-led Gemini, to join OpenAI — the move that sets his current affiliation.
body.zh: Shazeer 离开曾共同领导 Gemini 的谷歌加入 OpenAI，这次变动确定了他目前的任职机构。

title.en: Jim Cramer Calls Noam Shazeer’s Jump to OpenAI a ‘Coup’ as the AI Talent War Heats Up
title.zh: Jim Cramer Calls Noam Shazeer’s Jump to OpenAI a ‘Coup’ as the AI Talent War Heats Up

body.en: CNBC's Jim Cramer called Shazeer's move from Google back to OpenAI a 'coup' in the ongoing AI talent war.
body.zh: CNBC的吉姆·克莱默称沙泽尔从谷歌重返OpenAI是这场AI人才争夺战中的一次“政变”式挖角。

title.en: Google Gemini co-lead Noam Shazeer to join IPO-bound OpenAI
title.zh: Google Gemini co-lead Noam Shazeer to join IPO-bound OpenAI

body.en: Noam Shazeer left his role co-leading Google Gemini to join OpenAI ahead of its IPO.
body.zh: Noam Shazeer离开了谷歌Gemini联合负责人的职位，在OpenAI IPO前加入该公司。

title.en: OpenAI poach Noam Shazeer from Google Gemini team in major AI talent shift
title.zh: OpenAI poach Noam Shazeer from Google Gemini team in major AI talent shift

body.en: Shazeer left Google's Gemini team to rejoin OpenAI, a major talent shift for both labs.
body.zh: 沙泽尔离开谷歌Gemini团队重返OpenAI，是两家实验室之间的一次重大人才流动。

title.en: Two years after a $2.7 billion return to Google, AI pioneer Noam Shazeer is leaving for OpenAI
title.zh: Two years after a $2.7 billion return to Google, AI pioneer Noam Shazeer is leaving for OpenAI

body.en: Shazeer leaves Google for OpenAI, two years after the $2.7B Character.AI deal that brought him back to Google.
